assets.prompt: Create a production pixel-art sprite sheet for ORVASK, a dystopian industrial tower game. Reference image 1 is the approved eavesback creature STYLE ONLY, reference 2 the approved hero STYLE ONLY, reference 3 the environment palette. Match their very broad coherent pixel clusters, muted blue-grey/oxidized brown masses, low internal contrast and selective dark edges. Do not copy the hero costume or creature anatomy. NEW SUBJECT: a pure mechanical lift fire-door caretaker called Closure Watch. A tall hunched humanlike work automaton with a small bowed sealed head, a SINGLE large clockwork spool on its upper back, heavy stubby grounded feet, two immense rectangular asymmetrical door-panel forearms. No human flesh. Broad old blue-grey panels, dark desaturated blue inner frame, small tarnished brass joints, ONE muted amber pressure chamber on chest. Not a shiny combat mech, not a skeleton. Memorable silhouette, few large shapes, no tiny gears or rivets or intricate wires. LEFT-FACING three-quarter SIDE VIEW suitable for a side-view battle, faces hero on left. Two frames in ONE horizontal sprite atlas, exact equal left/right half cells, each entire body fits with ample transparent margins. LEFT CELL: CLOSED/guarding, door forearms held together shielding chest, hunched. RIGHT CELL: OPEN/charging, same character same scale same feet baseline, arms pivot out and slightly forward revealing large chest pressure chamber; legs and head identity identical. The open pose should still face left and fit entirely in its half. SOURCE canvas about 1536x1024 landscape, evenly spaced, both feet baselines at 88 percent height, tallest head around 15 percent height. Runtime visible height about 145 screen pixels; keep extremely simple broad clusters like reference, NO dense seams, grain, highlights, continuous black outline, optical blur, text, UI, labels, grids, shadows, ground, background. Genuine transparent background alpha. Only these two sprites, separate with an empty gutter.
